rows.quote: For breast cancer, we used GWAS summary statistics combining studies from the BCAC as well as other GWAS studies, containing 10.8 million SNPs from 133,384 cases and 113,789 controls of European ancestry [24].
rows.reference_quote: Zhang H Ahearn TU Lecarpentier J Barnes D Beesley J Qi G Genome-wide association study identifies 32 novel breast cancer susceptibility loci from overall and subtype-specific analyses Nat Genet 2020 52 6 572 581 10.1038/s41588-020-0609-2 32424353 PMC7808397
rows.coder_note: Sentence gives the exact 133,384 cases and 113,789 controls (consortium plus other GWAS) and attributes them to reference 24, whose DOI is this row's; the DOI is shared by two other rows of the same paper, which the exact counts exclude. For the checker: the same passage describes a second, differently labelled dataset (OncoArray, iCOGS and other GWAS, reference 25) used for receptor-subtype analyses; the paper's own label for the consortium-named data is the one coded here.

rows.quote: For the clustering analysis, we meta-analysed BMI GWAS summary statistics meta-analysis results from FinnGen (release 9) [21] and the GIANT consortium (2018 release) [22].
rows.coder_note: Sentence states 'FinnGen (release 9)', the release number of one row only. The participant count given in the next sentence is an analysis subset and differs from the release total; the stated release number settles the row.

The sentence calls the data the consortium's 2018 release, while the reference it cites carries the DOI of the 2015 rows and the stated European sample size equals that of a 2015 row; the year in the sentence and the cited record point to different candidate rows. Flag for adjudication.

rows.quote: Logistic regression models were run with the PGSBMI of each cluster as predictor of breast cancer for women in the UK Biobank.
rows.coder_note: Passages describe the outcome data as the authors' own analysis of the cohort's individual-level data (case definition from registry fields, one-sample MR), not a published GWAS release; no dictionary outcome row is such a dataset. For the checker: this is a judgement between dataset_absent_from_dictionary and release_not_identified.
